title: Terrible Quality and Size is Misleading
text:
First off, I ordered two subscriptions, one medium and one large to compare the difference. There is NONE! Same treats and toys.

Second, I have a puggle and black lab and they tore the stuffing out of the toys in under 5 minutes. That is some poor quality stitching.

The boxes are cute, but I paid for quality- not cuteness.
label: negative
